english.title: Vehicle - trade licence holder use on vehicle class not authorised

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES REGISTRATION AND LICENSING REGULATIONS 2002

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a trade licence displayed on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), a trade plate, when that vehicle was not within the classes of vehicle specified in section 11 of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 and was not being used for one or more of the purposes prescribed for the holder of the licence in accordance with regulation 38 of and Schedule 6 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 6 of Schedule 6 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 and section 59(1) and (2)(b) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

english.notes: (i) This offence document replaces RV02041 from 1st October 2014. For any offences of this nature committed before this date, RV02041 should be used (H4972).
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant being the holder of a trade licence displayed on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), a trade plate, when that vehicle was not within the classes of vehicle specified in section 11 of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 and was not being used for one or more of the purposes prescribed for the holder of the licence in accordance with regulation 38 of and Schedule 6 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002.
